China Mail Causal Knowledge Graph: Topic, 0.30

Version: Event, 0.30 | Event, 0.35 | Topic, 0.30 | Topic, 0.35

This graph is built from 943 pages of the China Mail, published 1 Apr 1925 to 30 Nov 1926, covering the 1925 Canton–Hongkong strike. Arrows represent cause/effect relationships stated in the newspaper, as extracted by a local model and not yet hand-checked.

3479 claims: 2558 arrows (177 with more than one claim), 2457 groups (1068 with one description), and 669 claims with cause and effect in the same group, listed on that node.

The graph is interactive so you can pan and zoom in/out with the mouse.
Click a node to view a list of that item's causal relationships.
Click an item in that list, or an arrow, to view the exact quote.
